name: LiveArchive design system export
describes: What the app does today. Sources: src/styles/tokens.css, src/styles/landing-look.css, src/styles/ticket-styles.css, src/styles/motion.css, src/services/theme.ts, src/components/ui/, REQUIREMENTS.md section 3, docs/architecture/15-shared-ui.md.

principles.rule: Missing data stays missing and the UI says so. No defaults, no inference.
principles.ui: Label gaps ("Not known yet", "No date yet"); empty is a valid answer.

principles.rule: Saving never waits on research, quota or a network call.
principles.ui: A name alone saves. Slow work runs after save.

principles.rule: Later, costly stages run only when asked for, on saved data.
principles.ui: An explicit button starts them; a failure there never touches what was saved.

principles.rule: Each value records where it came from: you, or a cited source.
principles.ui: Values can show their source and quote.

principles.rule: The app suggests; it never overwrites what you typed.
principles.ui: One-tap offers; a worked-out value is lit with a marker until you pick.

principles.rule: One line of text in; structured fields out.
principles.ui: New fields go on the detail view, never the entry line.

principles.rule: Shared facts are stored apart from your personal log.
Scarce calls run only where they pay; on quota the job waits.
No lists of real-world names in code.
principles.ui: Suggestions come from your data or sources.

principles.rule: Delight comes from small, reliable moments, not more screens.
principles.ui: A one-tap "Is it one of these?", milestones, a brief burst.

color.model: UI uses semantic --la-* utilities (bg-surface-1, text-text, border-line, bg-accent-fill, text-on-accent, text-good/warn/bad). Legacy Tailwind zinc (surfaces, text) and violet (accent) classes remain mapped for older screens.
color.accentAttribute: data-accent on <html>; --accent-* scales are mapped onto --la-accent* and legacy --color-violet-*

second.use: Emphasis words in poster headings, post-it tape and tones, stamps and highlights. Never for status (good, warn, bad keep theirs).
second.rule: Every accent has a partner in dark and light; tests/landingLook.test.ts fails when one is missing.

themes.dark: Tailwind defaults for zinc and every hue; violet = accent at the same step.

lightRemap.rule: Mirror zinc and the light and dark ends of each coloured scale (300 text becomes 700, 950 tints become 50). Steps 500 to 700 of the accent stay, so white text on accent buttons keeps working.

storage.where: localStorage, per device, read in try/catch
storage.prePaint: Inline script in app.html sets data-theme, data-accent and data-stub before the app draws; keep it in step with src/services/theme.ts

radius.note: Pills use rounded-full; menus, popovers and toasts still use rounded-xl, sheets rounded-2xl.

sm.use: touch targets shrink from 44 to 36 px

slideOver.use: DetailShell slide-over (92% width); below it a bottom sheet (92% height)

split.use: DetailShell split view with a 240 px list

detailTwoColumn.use: event detail body goes to two columns

reducedMotion: Confetti (celebrate) and Burst do not run at all under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Transitions on Switch, the save flash and the app header use motion-reduce:transition-none.
Home cards drop hover lift and scale (motion-reduce:transform-none).
landingLook: Buttons lift 1.5px, grow 2% and glow in the accent on hover (btn-pop) and press to 94% on tap; never tilt.
Post-its rise in and fade in on load, use a slightly transparent drop-shadow, and straighten from their resting tilt, lift and grow 2% on hover; tape lifts; icon hops.
The backdrop pairs a 400s rotating, 50s drifting contour layer (5% opacity) with a non-rotating 10px sliding dot grid (14s, 10% opacity).
The heartbeat logo beats every 1.45s and matches the primary accent color; CSS switches to a still version under reduced motion.
All of these stop under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

notDefinedYet: type scale beyond the poster heading sizes (Tailwind default sizes)

components.name: Button
components.purpose: The one text button. Lifts 1.5px, grows 2% and glows in the accent on hover (btn-pop, about half the landing page's); IconButton, MenuButton and Quick add share it.
components.a11y: Defaults to type="button"; outline-accent focus outline.

components.name: IconButton
components.purpose: Icon-only button.
components.a11y: label is the aria-label and the Tooltip; 44 px on phones, 36 px from sm.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Short name on hover or focus.
components.a11y: Bubble is aria-hidden; the wrapped control keeps its own name.

components.name: Pill
components.purpose: Small rounded label for a short fact.

props.tone: neutral | accent | good | warn | info | highlight | inferred

components.a11y: Good and warn always carry words, never colour alone.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Anchored panel for help text.
components.a11y: Trigger is role=button with aria-expanded; panel role=dialog; closes on outside tap or Escape.

components.name: MenuButton
components.purpose: Shows the current choice and opens a list.
components.a11y: aria-haspopup=listbox, options role=option with aria-selected; arrows, Home, End; focus on current when opened; closes on pick, outside tap, Escape.

components.name: Segmented
components.purpose: Exactly one of a few side-by-side options; the chosen fill slides to the new choice. Use it for every such row (order, view, year, weekend), never a hand-built row of toggle buttons.

props.label: string
props.compact: boolean: smaller segments for a narrow row
props.stretch: boolean: options share the row's width (full-width row on a phone)
props.iconOnly: boolean: icons only; the label becomes the button's name and tooltip

states: chosen (tick + tint, slides with a spring; at once under reduced motion)
components.a11y: role=radiogroup/radio; roving tabindex; arrows move and choose.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Navigation between pages or views: the top Home/Library/Explore row and every page strip.
states: open (bold, raised folder or underline, aria-current=page)
changing: the folder slides, squishes slightly taller in motion (constant area) and eases back on arrival, the underline slides with a squash, the new tab's icon hops; all off under reduced motion
components.a11y: nav with aria-label; aria-current=page on the open tab; compact tabs keep their label as the name.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: On/off setting.
components.a11y: role=switch, aria-checked; state written as "On"/"Off".

components.name: Notice
components.purpose: Visible message for a result, caveat or warning.
components.a11y: warning is role=alert; others role=status.

components.name: Callout
components.purpose: Dismissible page tip.
components.a11y: aside "Tip"; 40 px dismiss button "Dismiss this tip"; storage in try/catch.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Brief confirmation, optionally with Undo.
components.a11y: Polite live region.

components.name: Confirm
components.purpose: Only for irreversible actions.
components.a11y: Built on Dialog.

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Modal shell: side panel or centred card.
components.a11y: aria-modal; focus moves in, Tab trapped, Escape and outside press close, scroll locked, focus returns; blurs the active field first so its save runs.

components.name: Sheet
components.purpose: Bottom sheet on phones, card from sm.
components.a11y: aria-modal; Escape and backdrop close; focus returns to opener.

components.name: DetailShell
components.purpose: Record detail in three widths: split, slide-over, sheet.
components.a11y: J/K or arrows move, N next with gap, Escape closes; keys ignored while typing or in a choice group.

components.name: SaveStatus
components.purpose: Whether edits are saved.
components.a11y: Polite live region; retry is a button.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: Vertical list of job steps.
components.a11y: Each state has an icon and a word.

components.name: BackToTop
components.purpose: Text pill after about one screen of scroll.
components.a11y: aria-label "Back to top"; sits above the phone + button.

components.name: FilterControls
components.purpose: Filters button, panel, select pills and yes/no toggle.
components.a11y: Select has aria-label; button has aria-expanded.

components.name: Burst
components.purpose: Small ring of marks on a celebrated tap.
components.a11y: aria-hidden; never runs under reduced motion.

components.name: celebrate (confetti.ts)
components.purpose: Confetti for milestones.
components.a11y: Canvas aria-hidden; skipped under reduced motion.

components.name: PosterHeading
components.purpose: Page, section, panel and dialog titles in the condensed poster face, capitals.

props.second: optional words shown after the text in the second colour

components.a11y: Renders a real h1 to h3; capitals come from CSS, so screen readers hear the words as typed. Not for names of things, which keep font-display.

components.name: PostIt
components.purpose: A taped paper note for callouts, tips and highlights.

props.tilt: resting tilt in degrees, keep within -3 to 3 (default 0)
props.delay: optional entrance animation delay in seconds
props.title: optional, shown as a poster heading
props.onClick: optional; makes the whole note one button (a link card) with the focus ring

states: entering (rises up and fades in on load)
components.a11y: Decorative tape and icon are aria-hidden; content reads the same without motion. Put any action inside as a real button or link.

components.name: AppBackdrop
components.purpose: The rotating, drifting contour texture (5% opacity, 400s spin, 50s drift) and non-rotating sliding dot grid (10% opacity, 10px, 14s slide) behind every page, tinted with the accent.
components.a11y: aria-hidden, pointer-events none; still under reduced motion. Mount once inside a relative isolate root.

components.name: Logo
components.purpose: The heartbeat logo: the waveform beats and the pin pulses with it, tinted with the primary accent.
components.a11y: Inline SVG tinted with primary accent CSS variables; CSS swaps to the still group under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Ticket
components.purpose: The true ticket stub for an event (body and stub end, real notches), skinned by the ticket style.
components.a11y: Stub atoms are aria-hidden; StubSentence gives the one sentence they read. See docs/archive/ticket-stub.md.

components.name: StubHeader
components.purpose: The framing stub over lists (Summary years, Ranking groups); its title is a poster heading.
components.a11y: Perforations and notches are decorative.

components.name: Ledger
components.purpose: Shared ledger list container (Ledger.Row, Ledger.Separator) with accent edge bars and row-hover trail.
components.a11y: Row uses role=button when clickable with focus-visible outline.

components.name: DateStack
components.purpose: Compact stacked date badge (month, day, year) for ledger rows.
components.a11y: Plain text date; missing reads "No date".

components.name: KindPill
components.purpose: Festival or Concert pill with icon.
components.a11y: Always pairs icon with label.

components.name: HintPill
components.purpose: Compact status/action pill for event rows (gaps, needs review, busy).
components.a11y: Labelled text; never colour alone.

components.name: Equalizer
components.purpose: Three-bar animated music equalizer indicator for active lookups.
components.a11y: aria-hidden; pair with visible status text.

components.name: NameList
components.purpose: Comma-joined list of artist/person names in font-display.
components.a11y: Semantic inline text.

components.name: Stars
components.purpose: Interactive or read-only 5-star rating control.
components.a11y: Each star is a labelled button; tapping the current rating clears it.

components.name: ReadRow
components.purpose: Detail field row with label, value, source/info popover, save flash, and inline edit slot.
components.a11y: Click/Enter opens inline editor; source details sit in Popover.

components.name: SourceIcon
components.purpose: Small icon mapping a source key (ticketmaster, setlistfm, clashfinder, etc.) to a Lucide icon.
components.a11y: aria-hidden beside source label.

components.name: TipsContext
components.purpose: Dismissible page-tip provider and header ? toggle button.
components.a11y: Toggle announces state; folded tips can be recalled.

components.name: VersionPicker
components.purpose: Dropdown/segmented version selector for multi-versioned views.
components.a11y: Uses MenuButton / Segmented keyboard contract.

appSpecific: DemoPrompt (sample-mode explainer) is LiveArchive-only and not part of the export.

display.use: names of things (artists, editions, series, events) and the ticket headline

poster.use: page, section, panel and dialog titles, always in capitals (PosterHeading)

typography.scale: Tailwind default sizes. Poster headings: md text-2xl sm:text-3xl, lg clamp(32px,5vw,48px), xl clamp(44px,7vw,72px); page titles text-4xl.

ticketStyles.attribute: data-stub on <html> or on any element
ticketStyles.contract: A style sets only the module's tokens (paper and ink, type, texture, frame). Add one: a CSS block, an entry in STUB_STYLES (src/services/theme.ts), its fonts in app.html. tests/ticketStyles.test.ts keeps list and module in step.
